The package contains disposal-site polygons, methane estimates and reconciliation code. Its stated coverage is India, with a global facility comparison. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. Satellite-derived emission estimates are model-dependent; verification claims in the deposit were not independently audited. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
